skill.summary: Manage automated backups for OpenClaw configurations, clean expired backups, and create pre-modification snapshots. 自动化备份管理系统：配置备份、过期清理、修改前快照。

latestVersion.changelog: Bilingual documentation update (English + Chinese)! 1) SKILL.md now fully bilingual with complete English/Chinese sections 2) Emergency recovery guides bilingual (~/OPENCLAW_EMERGENCY_RECOVERY.md and ~/.openclaw/backups/README.md) 3) All user-facing text now in both languages for better accessibility 4) Improved Chinese localization for native speakers
